items.title: Revvity (NYSE:RVTY) Reports Upbeat Q2 CY2026
items.summary: Life sciences company Revvity (NYSE:RVTY) reported Q2 CY2026 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 7.2% year on year to $729.7 million. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $2.85 billion at the midpoint came in 0.5% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.41 per share was 15.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
